name: Eyes of Charming

source.note: Entered from knowledge of the 2024 DMG (personal build); check every number against the book.

powers.name: Charm Person
powers.text: 1 charge: cast Charm Person (save DC 13) on a humanoid within 30 ft.

text: These crystal lenses fit over the eyes. They have 3 charges. While wearing them, you can expend 1 charge to cast Charm Person (save DC 13) on a humanoid within 30 feet of you, provided that you and the target can see each other. The lenses regain all expended charges daily at dawn.
